select a.branch_code,a.item_rmb AS acct_beg_num,b.item_rmb AS acct_curr_num,c.item_rmb AS acct_curr_scene_num,d.item_rmb AS acct_curr_ol_num,e.item_rmb AS acct_curr_wit_num,
 f.item_rmb AS acct_canc_curr_num,t.item_rmb AS acct_sleep_to_norm_num,g.item_rmb AS acct_total_end_num,
a.item_rmb+b.item_rmb-f.item_rmb+t.item_rmb-g.item_rmb AS diff_val,20241129 AS check_date
   from (select branch_code, sum(case 
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_rmb,
             sum(case  when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_sb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='USD' and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='USD' and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)  item_hb
        from rmc.dw_tb_tzjzhtj  a 
        where khflfs in(1,91,9)
             and biz_date=get_last_n_txdate(CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01'),-1)
             and branch_code='0230'
              group by branch_code
            ) a 
      left join(   --本期新开户数'
      select '本期新开户数',
              9 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_USD+ZJKHS_WS_USD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_JZ+ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD+ZJKHS_XC_USD+ZJKHS_WS_USD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129' 
              group by branch_code) b
       on a.branch_code=b.branch_code
       left join (
      SELECT '本期新开资金户数(现场)',/*本期新开户数 - 网上开户数 - 见证开户数*/
       10 SN,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_XC+ZJKHS_XC_HKD+ZJKHS_XC_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'   
              group by branch_code) c
       on a.branch_code=c.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期新开资金户数(网上)',
              11 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_WS+ZJKHS_WS_HKD+ZJKHS_WS_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129' 
              group by branch_code )d
       on a.branch_code=d.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期新开资金户数(见证)',
              12 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJKHS_JZ+ZJKHS_JZ_HKD+ZJKHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  
              group by branch_code
) e
       on a.branch_code=e.branch_code
      left join(
      select '本期销户数',
              13 sn,branch_code,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC+ZJXHS_WS+ZJXHS_JZ) item_rmb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC_HKD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_HKD) item_sb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC_USD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_USD) item_hb,
            sum(ZJXHS_XC+ZJXHS_WS+ZJXHS_JZ+ZJXHS_XC_HKD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_HKD+ZJXHS_XC_USD+ZJXHS_WS_HKD+ZJXHS_JZ_USD) hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033  a
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  
              group by branch_code)f
       on a.branch_code=f.branch_code
     left join(
     SELECT '本期休眠账户数转正常账户数' ,
        14 SN ,branch_code,
       /*T.GDJHBZ*/ XMJHS item_rmb,
       0 AS ITEM_SB,
       0 AS ITEM_HB,
       /*T.GDJHBZ*/ XMJHS AS HJ,
       0 AS ITEM_SB_RMB,
       0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
  FROM (
          SELECT branch_code,SUM(XMJHS) XMJHS
             FROM base_app_cisp.tcispsjbctj_p99000033 
        where  biz_date BETWEEN  CONCAT(substr( 20241129,1,6),'01') and '20241129'  group by branch_code ) 
             )T  
       on a.branch_code=t.branch_code
     left join (
        select '客户帐户期末合计户数',
              18 sn,branch_code,
              item_rmb,
              item_sb,
              item_hb,
              item_rmb+item_sb+item_hb hj,
              0 AS ITEM_SB_rmb,
              0 AS ITEM_HB_RMB
        from (select branch_code, sum(case 
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='RMB'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end) item_rmb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='HKD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)
             item_sb,
             sum(case 
                              when currency_code='USD'  and khflfs = 1  then  yxhs
                              when currency_code='USD'  and khflfs = 9  then  yxhs*(-1) else 0 end)
             item_hb
        from rmc.dw_tb_tzjzhtj  a 
        where khflfs in(1,91,9)
            and biz_date= '20241129'
            and branch_code='0230'
            group by branch_code
            ) b
            ) g
       on a.branch_code=g.branch_code

-- name test_v8trade
-- type Spark SQL
-- author wanghk@dwzq.com.cn
-- create time 2023-11-22 11:00:06
-- desc 



--   insert overwrite table base_app_cisp.t_cisp_y8_busi partition(biz_month)
  SELECT
       ${bdp.system.premonth} fmonth,
       A.branch_code,
       A0.LN1B,A0.LN1E,
       nvl(A1.LN2B,0) ln2B,nvl(A1.LN2E,0) ln2E,
       A0.LN1B-nvl(A1.LN2B,0) LN3B,A0.LN1E-nvl(A1.LN2E,0) LN3E,
       A2.LN4B,A2.LN4E,
       B.LN5B,B.LN5E,
       nvl(C.LN7B,0)+nvl(D.LN8B,0) LN6B,nvl(C.LN7E,0)+nvl(D.LN8E,0) LN6E,
       C.LN7B,C.LN7E,
       NVL(D.LN8B,0) LN8B,NVL(D.LN8E,0) LN8E,
       I.LN9E,
       I.LN10E,
       I.LN11E,
       nvl(C.LN13E,0)+nvl(D.LN14E,0) AS LN12E,
       C.LN13E,
       nvl(D.LN14E,0) LN14E,
       A0.LN22B+H.LN23B LN21B,A0.LN22E+G.LN23E LN21E,
       A0.LN22B,A0.LN22E,
       H.LN23B,G.LN23E,
       h.fzje,g.fzje,   --  比例在查询时根据担保价值和负债金额进行计算获取
       CC.LN25B,CC.LN25E,
       h.LN21B,g.LN21E,
       ${bdp.system.premonth} as biz_month
 FROM 
(select trim(bran_entry_value) BRANCH_CODE,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=35 and entry_code ='9901') A
left join 
 (
-- /*期末信用资金账户数 */
SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
        SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1E,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN
              T.YXHS ELSE 0
           END) AS LN1B,
       SUM(CASE
             WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  THEN
              T.zjye ELSE 0
           END) AS LN22B,   --  期初资金
       SUM(CASE
                 WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN
                  T.ZJYE ELSE 0
               END) AS LN22E    --  期末资金
  FROM base_app_cisp.TB_RZRQ_TZJZHTJ T
 WHERE T.KHFLFS in(0, 1)
   AND T.RQ IN (${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}, ${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
   AND T.ZHLB = 2
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) A0 on a.BRANCH_CODE=a0.BRANCH_CODE
   left join
   (
   select A.BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2E,
          sum(case when (bal_status<>3 or (bal_status=3 and bal_closedate>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})) 
            and bal_opendate<=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then 1 else 0 end) ln2B
        from (SELECT branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no as capital_account,
               min(cap_acct_state_code) as bal_status,
               min(open_date) as bal_opendate,
               min(CLOSE_date) as bal_closedate
          from base_data.tac_cap_acct 
          group by branch_code,cust_no,cap_acct_no) a
        join 
        (select a.cust_no, b.cap_acct_no as capital_account,a.branch_code
                From base_data.tpt_cust a
                join base_data.tac_cap_acct b on (b.ACCT_ATTR_CODE =2 and a.cust_no =b.cust_no)
                where a.cust_type_code = 1) b on (a.branch_code=b.branch_code and a.capital_account=b.capital_account)
      GROUP BY A.BRANCH_CODE
   )a1 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A1.BRANCH_CODE
   left join
   (
   select BRANCH_CODE,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4E,
          sum(case when rq=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} then hs else 0 end) ln4B
        from base_app_cisp.tb_rzrq_tzqzhtj b
      where b.rq in(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date})
      and b.khflfs in(1,0)
      GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   )a2 on A.BRANCH_CODE=A2.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5E,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} AND ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}>=20210220 THEN T.RZED+T.RQED ELSE 0 END ) AS LN5B  --  ,   --  证券分支机构所有客户已获批可使用的授信额度 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
  left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE T.RQ IN ( ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},${p_last_month_last_trade_date})
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) B ON A.BRANCH_CODE=B.BRANCH_CODE
   LEFT JOIN (
SELECT t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7E,   --  其中:融资余额 期末,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzye              ELSE 0 END)  AS LN7B,   --  其中:融资余额 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.RQ<=${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T1.brrzje               ELSE 0 END ) AS LN13E   --  其中:融资授信金额  期末
      FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczjtj T1
      left join (select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=34 and entry_code ='9901' and bran_entry_code = '8010') t2 on (t1.yyb = t2.bran_entry_value)
 WHERE  T1.RQ <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t1.rq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) C ON A.BRANCH_CODE=C.BRANCH_CODE
left join
(
SELECT  t2.entry_value BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25E,   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T1.rq<=concat(substr(${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31')  and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101') THEN T1.rzxzlx + T1.rqxzfy+rzxzfx+rqxzfx ELSE 0 END ) AS LN25B   --  证券分支机构融资融券收入 期初
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_khlxtj T1 ,(select trim(bran_entry_value) bran_entry_value,trim(entry_value) entry_value from rmdc.params_tb_dict_entry_map where version_id=35 and entry_code ='9901') t2
 WHERE T1.yyb=t2.bran_entry_value and 
   T1.rq <= concat(substr(${p_last_month_last_trade_date},1,6),'31') and t1.rq>=concat(substr(${bdp.system.premonth},1,4),'0101')
   GROUP BY t2.entry_value
   ) CC ON A.BRANCH_CODE=CC.BRANCH_CODE
  LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8E,   --  其中:融券市值 期末
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN T.ZXSZ ELSE 0 END) AS LN8B,   --  其中:融券市值 期初
       SUM(CASE WHEN T.qsrq > ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} THEN brrqje ELSE 0 END) AS LN14E   --  其中:融资授信金额
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_rczqtj T
 WHERE T.tx_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.tx_date>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
   and T.qsrq <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} and t.qsrq>=${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) D ON A.BRANCH_CODE=D.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zzc else 0 end ),0) AS LN21E,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23E,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.rq = CASE WHEN ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} =20200123 THEN 20200131 ELSE ${p_last_month_last_trade_date} END
   and t.rq = ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
   ) G ON A.BRANCH_CODE=G.BRANCH_CODE
 LEFT JOIN (
SELECT yyb as BRANCH_CODE,
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then ZZC else 0 end),0) AS LN21B,   --  担保物价值
       nvl(sum(shdbsz+szdbsz),0) ln23B,   --  证券市值
       NVL(SUM(case when zfz>0 then zfz else 0 end),0) FZJE
  FROM mda5.datacenter_tmr_htxxls T
 WHERE T.tx_date =${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date} and t.rq = ${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}
 GROUP BY yyb
   ) H  ON A.BRANCH_CODE=H.BRANCH_CODE
LEFT JOIN
( SELECT  BRANCH_CODE,
           COUNT(cust_no) AS LN9E, 
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '61' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN10E,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(T.busi_subj) = '64' THEN cust_no END ) AS LN11E
  FROM base_data.tev_sett_crdt T
 WHERE T.biz_date >${p_last_2_month_last_trade_date}  and  t.biz_date <= ${p_last_month_last_trade_date}
   AND TRIM(T.busi_subj) IN ('61', '64')
 GROUP BY BRANCH_CODE
) I ON A.BRANCH_CODE=I.BRANCH_CODE
;
